batchRequest.request: Mark two gifts wrapped and add a delivery deadline and a dietary-preferences note to the organizer.

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, limitCard, participantsCard, wishCard, checklistCard])
header = InlineHeader("Holiday Gift Exchange", "Secret Santa organizer with budget, wish lists and wrap tracking")
limitCard = Card([limitHeader, limitRow])
limitHeader = CardHeader("Spending Limit", "Agreed budget per gift")
limitRow = Stack([limitAmount, limitTags], "row", "m", "center", "between", true)
limitAmount = BoldText("number", "$30.00", "per person", "text", "lg")
limitTags = TagBlock(["Gifts under $30", "Shipping not included", "Handmade counts"], "md")
participantsCard = Card([partHeader, partTable])
partHeader = CardHeader("Participants", "Who is giving to whom")
partTable = Table([Col("Name", partNames), Col("Email", partEmails), Col("Giving To", partTargets), Col("Status", partStatus, "action")])
partNames = ["Ava Thompson", "Ben Carter", "Chloe Rivera", "Daniel Park", "Emma Wilson", "Farah Khan"]
partEmails = ["ava@example.com", "ben@example.com", "chloe@example.com", "daniel@example.com", "emma@example.com", "farah@example.com"]
partTargets = ["Hidden", "Hidden", "Hidden", "Hidden", "Hidden", "Hidden"]
partStatus = [Tag("Wrapped", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Wrapped", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Shopping", null, "sm", "warning"), Tag("Not started", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("Shopping", null, "sm", "warning"), Tag("Wrapped", null, "sm", "success")]
wishCard = Card([wishHeader, wishes])
wishHeader = CardHeader("Wish Lists", "Gift ideas from each participant")
wishes = Accordion([wishAva, wishBen, wishChloe])
wishAva = AccordionItem("ava", "Ava's Wish List", [avaList])
avaList = ListBlock([avaItem1, avaItem2, avaItem3], "number")
avaItem1 = ListItem("Cozy knit socks", "Wool blend, size 9")
avaItem2 = ListItem("Ceramic pour-over set", "Any neutral color")
avaItem3 = ListItem("Mystery novel", "Anything by Tana French")
wishBen = AccordionItem("ben", "Ben's Wish List", [benList])
benList = ListBlock([benItem1, benItem2], "number")
benItem1 = ListItem("Bluetooth speaker", "Compact, waterproof")
benItem2 = ListItem("Coffee beans", "Medium roast, whole bean")
wishChloe = AccordionItem("chloe", "Chloe's Wish List", [chloeList])
chloeList = ListBlock([chloeItem1, chloeItem2], "number")
chloeItem1 = ListItem("Yoga mat", "Thick, non-slip")
chloeItem2 = ListItem("Plant care kit", "Succulent-friendly")
checklistCard = Card([checkHeader, checklist])
checkHeader = CardHeader("Wrapping Checklist", "Track gifts that are ready")
checklist = CheckBoxGroup("wrapped", [chkAva, chkBen, chkChloe, chkDaniel, chkEmma, chkFarah])
chkAva = CheckBoxItem("Ava Thompson", "Gift wrapped and labeled", "ava", true)
chkBen = CheckBoxItem("Ben Carter", "Gift wrapped and labeled", "ben", true)
chkChloe = CheckBoxItem("Chloe Rivera", "Gift wrapped and labeled", "chloe", false)
chkDaniel = CheckBoxItem("Daniel Park", "Gift wrapped and labeled", "daniel", false)
chkEmma = CheckBoxItem("Emma Wilson", "Gift wrapped and labeled", "emma", false)
chkFarah = CheckBoxItem("Farah Khan", "Gift wrapped and labeled", "farah", true)
request: Mark two gifts wrapped and add a delivery deadline and a dietary-preferences note to the organizer.
